Coram : DIPAK MISRA*, D.Y. CHANDRACHUD, A.M. KHANWILKAR
Maharashtra Village Panchayat Act, 1958: s.14(1)(j-3) and 53 – Disqualification under s. 14(1)(j-3) – Whether attracted, when encroachment is by the husband and father-in-law of the candidate and not by the candidate herself – Held: Legislative intent of s. has to be viewed very strictly – The word ‘person’ in s.14(1)(j-3) should not be construed narrowly – Therefore, when the candidate shares an encroached property and there is continuance, he/she has to be treated as disqualified – Interpretation of Statutes
Decision Date : 19-09-2018 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 6832/2018 | Disposal Nature : Dismissed | Bench : 3 Judges
